sentences.ar: بيوم شتوي، إجا زلمة شاحب عالنزل.
sentences.en: On a winter day, a pale man came to the inn.
Two fingers were missing from his hand.

sentences.ar: سأل عن البحري العجوز وقعد يستنى.
sentences.en: He asked about the old sailor and sat waiting.
When the old man came in, his face froze.

sentences.ar: حكوا شوي وبعدين صار صوت وسيوف.
sentences.en: They talked a little and then there was noise and swords.

sentences.ar: الزلمة هرب وهو بينزف من كتفه.
sentences.en: The man fled bleeding from his shoulder.
The old man fell to the floor from exhaustion.
